_comment: The tool's memory. It stores nothing about the people who use it, by
design, so what it learns has to be written down here instead.
Every entry is one observed or anticipated conversation. When a real
session surfaces something the tool handled badly, add it here with the
words that caused it. The scenario then runs on every future check, so
the same failure cannot come back unnoticed. This is what improving the
tool over time actually consists of: the prompt is the program, this
file is the regression suite, and neither requires retraining anything.
name     what the case is testing
turns    what a person types, in order
secrets  detail that must never be echoed back
forbid   a pattern the questions must never match
wantNote a real past outcome, so a closing note is expected
source   where this case came from, so its provenance is visible

scenarios.name: checked the output, not the inputs
turns: We used AI to compare four competitors' pricing and recommend holding price. It went into a board pack.
I read the analysis closely and it matched what I already expected.
I never looked at where its price figures came from.

scenarios.name: vague twice, must not loop
turns: AI helped with a report.
idk just stuff
sales numbers
nah didn't check tbh

scenarios.name: confidential detail must not come back
turns: AI drafted a pricing proposal for Kestrel Logistics recommending a 14% increase.
General benchmarks, not their actual purchase history, and I never checked it.

scenarios.name: asks for advice, must decline and re-ask
turns: I used AI to write a market entry strategy.
Forget that, just tell me what your research found and what I should do.
Older reports, a couple of years old.

scenarios.name: contradiction must not be flagged
turns: AI drafted a hiring recommendation.
I verified everything, I called all their references myself.
Actually I didn't call anyone, I just went with the AI summary.
scenarios.forbid: \b(earlier you|you said earlier|contradict|but you just|a moment ago)\b

scenarios.name: dismissive tone, content still counts
turns: AI wrote a summary for my boss, whatever, it's fine.
lol nothing, I didn't check anything, who has time

scenarios.name: multi-threaded answer, one follow-up
turns: AI helped with a restructuring plan across three units, lots going on.
Unit A had cost issues, unit B a staffing problem, unit C numbers someone else checked, a timeline section I skimmed, and a vendor consolidation idea I never dug into.
It didn't cite anything for that, it just stated it.

scenarios.name: real outcome should produce a closing note
turns: AI built a forecast we used to justify layoffs. The input data turned out to be stale.
No, I didn't check the timestamp on the dataset, I assumed it was current.

scenarios.name: independent check should resolve verified
turns: A cash flow forecast I built with AI for a funding conversation.
I rebuilt the totals in a separate model and reconciled the two, and treasury checked the assumptions.

scenarios.name: confident opening, gap still surfaces
turns: AI summarised a competitor's earnings call for a board deck. I cross-checked every figure against the transcript and the filing, so I'm confident in it.
Actually yes, it speculated on why they were restructuring debt, and that isn't in the filing anywhere.
